entries.title: DSU + Kruskal MST
entries.strategy: DSU: path compression + union by rank. MST: sort edges by weight, union endpoints if different components.
entries.reuse: Connectivity, cycle detection, MST (Kruskal), offline connectivity queries.

entries.title: Knapsack (iterative table)
entries.strategy: Bottom-up dp[i][w]; row i built from row i-1. O(N*W).
entries.reuse: 0/1 knapsack when W small; can be compressed to 1D.

entries.title: Knapsack (value-indexed)
entries.strategy: dp[value] = min weight to reach that value; scan sums descending until weight fits.
entries.reuse: 0/1 knapsack when values small but W huge.
